name: game-creation-studio
description: Design, prototype and test games; prepare and facilitate tabletop play with full board-game, GM and source-aware workflows.

interface.longDescription: Twenty-five full workflows cover game systems, board/card rules, production diagnostics and live tabletop preparation, facilitation, roleplay, safety and debriefs. Includes a read-only live-card checker. External game engines, services, rulebooks and recipient table data remain separate.
defaultPrompt: Design a small playable game and its next test.
Prepare a system-neutral one-shot run sheet from my supplied sources.
Give me one compact live GM intervention without inventing player motives.
